## Plan: Surface outstanding-items remediation (post-ProjectionMapping)

This draft plan reconciles both outstanding-item documents, excludes the already-fixed MORK ProjectionMapping work, and turns the remaining items into an execution sequence with explicit decision gates. The plan starts with truth-source cleanup, then resolves policy-level choices that affect architecture, then implements constrained technical remediations in Surface, Quantification, and Foundation, and ends with validation and release hygiene. It also resolves current doc drift where one outstanding file still states items as not built while the other reports partial implementation. ProjectionMapping is treated as complete, based on its presence in [ontology/mork/spec/Mork.ttl](ontology/mork/spec/Mork.ttl) and removal of proposed-vocabulary flow in [tools/surface/cli.py](tools/surface/cli.py) and [tools/surface/mork.py](tools/surface/mork.py).

**Steps**
1. Establish a single source of truth for outstanding status by merging and normalising [ontology/surface/docs/OUTSTANDING-ITEMS.md](ontology/surface/docs/OUTSTANDING-ITEMS.md) and [ontology/surface/docs/OUTSTANDING-ITEMS%202.md](ontology/surface/docs/OUTSTANDING-ITEMS%202.md), with explicit “Done / Deferred / Decision needed / Blocked” tags per item.
2. Confirm and freeze “already remediated” entries so they are elided from active backlog: ProjectionMapping, `elg:constrainedByContract`, and L9 shape replacement in [ontology/eligibility/README.md](ontology/eligibility/README.md), [ontology/eligibility/spec/eligibility.ttl](ontology/eligibility/spec/eligibility.ttl), and [ontology/eligibility/shapes/rules.ttl](ontology/eligibility/shapes/rules.ttl).
3. Run a governance decision record for X6 scope in Surface, choosing between “keep source-signature promotions in Surface with constraints” versus “move to MORK-only mapping concern,” then encode the decision in [docs/architecture/decisions/ADR-A16-surface-projection-mechanism.md](docs/architecture/decisions/ADR-A16-surface-projection-mechanism.md) and [ontology/surface/README.md](ontology/surface/README.md).
4. Resolve ADR-A01 convention conflict by deciding whether layer headers remain authored in README extraction blocks or only in `spec` files, then apply consistently across [docs/architecture/decisions/ADR-A01-layer-dependency-order.md](docs/architecture/decisions/ADR-A01-layer-dependency-order.md), [ontology/surface/README.md](ontology/surface/README.md), [ontology/eligibility/README.md](ontology/eligibility/README.md), and [ontology/behaviour/README.md](ontology/behaviour/README.md).
5. Define Foundation migration boundary from ADR-A12 for derived-artefact contracts, specifying what moves to Foundation vs stays layer-local, then stage changes in [docs/architecture/decisions/ADR-A12-identity-and-derivation-model.md](docs/architecture/decisions/ADR-A12-identity-and-derivation-model.md), [ontology/foundation/README.md](ontology/foundation/README.md), and [ontology/surface/README.md](ontology/surface/README.md).
6. Remediate `srf:RangePartitionPopulation` in two tracks: first Quantification partition semantics and checks, then Surface admission and compiler support. Target files include [ontology/quantification/README.md](ontology/quantification/README.md), [ontology/quantification/spec/quantification.ttl](ontology/quantification/spec/quantification.ttl), [ontology/quantification/shapes](ontology/quantification/shapes), [ontology/surface/README.md](ontology/surface/README.md), [ontology/surface/spec/surface.ttl](ontology/surface/spec/surface.ttl), [ontology/surface/shapes](ontology/surface/shapes), and [tools/surface](tools/surface).
7. Add formal stacking composition laws for depth greater than 1 before lifting release ceiling, covering hash-chain freshness, signature-scope propagation, same-profile constraint, and cycle rejection. Update [ontology/surface/README.md](ontology/surface/README.md), [ontology/surface/spec/surface.ttl](ontology/surface/spec/surface.ttl), [ontology/surface/shapes/structural.ttl](ontology/surface/shapes/structural.ttl), and compiler logic in [tools/surface](tools/surface).
8. Keep `srf:ExternalIndex` deferred but make deferral operational by adding explicit admission criteria and non-goals in [ontology/surface/README.md](ontology/surface/README.md) and [ontology/surface/shapes/constraints.ttl](ontology/surface/shapes/constraints.ttl), so it is visibly unavailable and test-covered.
9. Close parity gap by wiring Surface parity to the shared conformance corpus, not contract-generated questions only. Integrate parity runner in [tools/surface/parity.py](tools/surface/parity.py), CLI in [tools/surface/cli.py](tools/surface/cli.py), and shared test assets under [test/conformance](test/conformance) and [ontology/surface/test](ontology/surface/test).
10. Remediate entailment-regime limitations with an explicit strategy for `NoEntailment` vs reasoned modes, including handling for DefinitionOnly parity checks. Update [ontology/surface/README.md](ontology/surface/README.md), [tools/surface](tools/surface), and profile declarations in [ontology/surface/vocab/surface-vocab.ttl](ontology/surface/vocab/surface-vocab.ttl).
11. Finalise canonicalisation migration as a planned cutover runbook for `srf-canon/2`, including stale-surface expectations, regeneration order, and communication artifacts in [ontology/surface/execution/README%20(1).md](ontology/surface/execution/README%20(1).md), [ontology/surface/README.md](ontology/surface/README.md), and CI documentation.
12. Add mandatory validation gate coverage for SHACL execution and extraction drift checks. Standardise command usage and CI hooks around [tools/literate_extract.py](tools/literate_extract.py), Surface unit tests, parity checks, and SHACL validation scripts.

**Verification**
- Extraction drift: run `python3 tools/literate_extract.py --check`.
- Surface regression: run `python3 -m unittest tools.surface.test_surface -v`.
- Targeted interop: run `python3 -m unittest tools.surface.test_surface.MorkInteropTests -v`.
- Parity checks: run `python3 -m tools.surface parity --contracts ontology/surface/examples/employment-job-family.ttl`.
- SHACL validation: execute layer shape suites against fixtures once engine wiring is available, then capture pass/fail evidence in repository docs.

**Decisions**
- X6 placement: default to keeping constrained source-signature promotions in Surface, since existing Surface laws and examples already encode this model.
- ADR-A01 convention: default to README-authored headers with extraction as canonical workflow, because multiple layers already follow this pattern.
- ExternalIndex timing: default to remain deferred until a concrete deployment requirement appears.
- Stacking depth: default to retain depth cap at 1 until composition laws and tests in Step 7 are complete.
